segments.an5.57:1.1: “Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, ṭhānāni abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbāni itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
segments.an5.57:1.3: ‘Jarādhammomhi, jaraṃ anatīto’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
segments.an5.57:1.4: ‘Byādhidhammomhi, byādhiṃ anatīto’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
segments.an5.57:1.5: ‘Maraṇadhammomhi, maraṇaṃ anatīto’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
segments.an5.57:1.6: ‘Sabbehi me piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
segments.an5.57:1.8: Yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi – kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā – tassa dāyādo bhavissāmī’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
segments.an5.57:2.1: “Kiñca, bhikkhave, atthavasaṃ paṭicca ‘jarādhammomhi, jaraṃ anatīto’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā?
segments.an5.57:2.2: Atthi, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ yobbane yobbanamado, yena madena mattā kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti, vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti, manasā duccaritaṃ caranti.
segments.an5.57:2.3: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato yo yobbane yobbanamado so sabbaso vā pahīyati tanu vā pana hoti.
segments.an5.57:2.4: Idaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atthavasaṃ paṭicca ‘jarādhammomhi, jaraṃ anatīto’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
segments.an5.57:3.1: “Kiñca, bhikkhave, atthavasaṃ paṭicca ‘byādhidhammomhi, byādhiṃ anatīto’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā?
segments.an5.57:3.2: Atthi, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ ārogye ārogyamado, yena madena mattā kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti, vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti, manasā duccaritaṃ caranti.
segments.an5.57:3.3: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato yo ārogye ārogyamado so sabbaso vā pahīyati tanu vā pana hoti.
segments.an5.57:3.4: Idaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atthavasaṃ paṭicca ‘byādhidhammomhi, byādhiṃ anatīto’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
segments.an5.57:4.1: “Kiñca, bhikkhave, atthavasaṃ paṭicca ‘maraṇadhammomhi, maraṇaṃ anatīto’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā?
segments.an5.57:4.2: Atthi, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ jīvite jīvitamado, yena madena mattā kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti, vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti, manasā duccaritaṃ caranti.
segments.an5.57:4.3: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato yo jīvite jīvitamado so sabbaso vā pahīyati tanu vā pana hoti.
segments.an5.57:4.4: Idaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atthavasaṃ paṭicca ‘maraṇadhammomhi, maraṇaṃ anatīto’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
segments.an5.57:5.1: “Kiñca, bhikkhave, atthavasaṃ paṭicca ‘sabbehi me piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā?
segments.an5.57:5.2: Atthi, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ piyesu manāpesu yo chandarāgo yena rāgena rattā kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti, vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti, manasā duccaritaṃ caranti.
segments.an5.57:5.3: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato yo piyesu manāpesu chandarāgo so sabbaso vā pahīyati tanu vā pana hoti.
segments.an5.57:5.4: Idaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atthavasaṃ paṭicca ‘sabbehi me piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
segments.an5.57:6.1: “Kiñca, bhikkhave, atthavasaṃ paṭicca ‘kammassakomhi, kammadāyādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi – kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā – tassa dāyādo bhavissāmī’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā?
segments.an5.57:6.3: Atthi, bhikkhave, sattānaṃ kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ.
segments.an5.57:6.4: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato sabbaso vā duccaritaṃ pahīyati tanu vā pana hoti.
segments.an5.57:6.5: Idaṃ kho, bhikkhave, atthavasaṃ paṭicca ‘kammassakomhi, kammadāyādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammapaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi – kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā – tassa dāyādo bhavissāmī’ti abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā.
segments.an5.57:7.1: “Sa kho [sace (pī. ka.)] so, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an5.57:7.2: ‘na kho ahaññeveko jarādhammo [ahañceveko jarādhammomhi (ka.)] jaraṃ anatīto, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbe sattā jarādhammā jaraṃ anatītā’ti.
segments.an5.57:7.3: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati.
segments.an5.57:7.4: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
segments.an5.57:7.5: Tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṃyojanāni sabbaso pahīyanti anusayā byantīhonti. “Sa kho so, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an5.57:8.1: ‘na kho ahaññeveko byādhidhammo byādhiṃ anatīto, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbe sattā byādhidhammā byādhiṃ anatītā’ti.
segments.an5.57:8.2: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati.
segments.an5.57:8.3: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
segments.an5.57:8.4: Tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṃyojanāni sabbaso pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti. “Sa kho so, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an5.57:9.1: ‘na kho ahaññeveko maraṇadhammo maraṇaṃ anatīto, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbe sattā maraṇadhammā maraṇaṃ anatītā’ti.
segments.an5.57:9.2: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati.
segments.an5.57:9.3: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
segments.an5.57:9.4: Tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṃyojanāni sabbaso pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti. “Sa kho so, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an5.57:10.1: ‘na kho mayhevekassa sabbehi piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbesaṃ sattānaṃ piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo’ti.
segments.an5.57:10.2: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati.
segments.an5.57:10.3: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
segments.an5.57:10.4: Tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṃyojanāni sabbaso pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhonti. “Sa kho so, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an5.57:11.1: ‘na kho ahaññeveko kammassako kammadāyādo kammayoni kammabandhu kammappaṭisaraṇo, yaṃ kammaṃ karissāmi – kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā – tassa dāyādo bhavissāmi;
segments.an5.57:11.2: atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbe sattā kammassakā kammadāyādā kammayoni kammabandhu kammappaṭisaraṇā, yaṃ kammaṃ karissanti – kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā – tassa dāyādā bhavissantī’ti.
segments.an5.57:11.3: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhato maggo sañjāyati.
segments.an5.57:11.4: So taṃ maggaṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti.
segments.an5.57:11.5: Tassa taṃ maggaṃ āsevato bhāvayato bahulīkaroto saṃyojanāni sabbaso pahīyanti, anusayā byantīhontī”ti.
segments.an5.57:12.3: Yathā dhammā tathā sattā [santā (syā. kaṃ.)], jigucchanti puthujjanā.
segments.an5.57:13.3: Na metaṃ patirūpassa, mama evaṃ vihārino.
segments.an5.57:15.1: “Sabbe made abhibhosmi, nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato [nekkhamme daṭṭhu khemataṃ (a. ni.3.39) ubhayatthapi aṭṭhakathāya sameti];
segments.an5.57:15.3: Tassa me ahu ussāho, nibbānaṃ abhipassato.

lines: Sattame jarādhammomhīti jarāsabhāvo amhi.
Jaraṃ anatītoti jaraṃ anatikkanto, antojarāya eva carāmi.
Sesapadesupi eseva nayo.
Kammassakotiādīsu kammaṃ mayhaṃ sakaṃ attano santakanti kammassako amhi.
Kammassa dāyādoti kammadāyādo, kammaṃ mayhaṃ dāyajjaṃ santakanti attho.
Kammaṃ mayhaṃ yoni kāraṇanti kammayoni.
Kammaṃ mayhaṃ bandhūti kammabandhu, kammañātakoti attho.
Kammaṃ mayhaṃ paṭisaraṇaṃ patiṭṭhāti kammapaṭisaraṇo.
Tassa dāyādo bhavissāmīti tassa kammassa dāyādo tena dinnaphalapaṭiggāhako bhavissāmīti attho.
Yobbanamadoti yobbanaṃ ārabbha uppannamado.
Sesesupi eseva nayo.
Maggo sañjāyatīti lokuttaramaggo sañjāyati.
Saṃyojanāni sabbaso pahīyantīti dasa saṃyojanāni sabbaso pahīyanti.
Anusayā byantīhontīti satta anusayā vigatantā paricchinnā parivaṭumā honti.
Evamettha heṭṭhā pañcasu ṭhānesu vipassanā kathitā, imesu pañcasu lokuttaramaggo.
Idāni gāthāhi kūṭaṃ gaṇhanto byādhidhammātiādimāha.
Tattha ñatvā dhammaṃ nirūpadhinti upadhirahitaṃ arahattamaggaṃ ñatvā.
Sabbe made abhibhosmīti sabbe ime tayopi made adhibhaviṃ, atikkamma ṭhitosmīti attho.
Nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khematoti pabbajjaṃ khemato disvā.
Tassa me ahu ussāho, nibbānaṃ abhipassatoti tassa mayhaṃ nibbānaṃ abhipassantassa vāyāmo ahosi.
Anivatti bhavissāmīti pabbajjato anivattiko bhavissāmi, brahmacariyavāsato anivattiko, sabbaññutaññāṇato anivattiko bhavissāmi.
Brahmacariyaparāyaṇoti maggabrahmacariyaparāyaṇo.
Iminā lokuttaro aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo kathitoti.

lines: Sattame jarādhammoti dhamma -saddo “asammosadhammo nibbānan”tiādīsu (su. ni.763) viya pakatipariyāyo, tasmā jarāpakatiko jiṇṇasabhāvoti attho.
Tenāha “jarāsabhāvo”tiādi.
Sesapadesupi eseva nayo.
Kammunā dātabbaṃ ādiyatīti kammadāyādo, attanā yathūpacitakammaphalabhāgīti attho.
Taṃ pana dāyajjaṃ kāraṇūpacārena vadanto “kammaṃ mayhaṃ dāyajjaṃ santakanti attho”ti āha yathā “kusalānaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ samādānahetu, evamidaṃ puññaṃ vaḍḍhatī”ti (dī. ni.3.80).
Yonīhi phalaṃ sabhāvato bhinnampi abhinnaṃ viya missitaṃ hoti.
Tenāha “kammaṃ mayhaṃ yoni kāraṇan”ti.
Mamattavasena bajjhantīti bandhū, ñāti sālohito ca, kammaṃ pana ekantasambandhavāti āha “kammaṃ mayhaṃ bandhū”ti.
Patiṭṭhāti avassayo.
Kammasadiso hi sattānaṃ avassayo natthi.
Yobbanaṃ ārabbha uppannamadoti “mahallakakāle puññaṃ karissāma, daharamha tāvā”ti yobbanaṃ apassāya mānakaraṇaṃ.

“Ahaṃ nirogo saṭṭhi vā sattati vā vassāni atikkantāni, na me harītakakhaṇḍampi khāditabbaṃ, ime panaññe ‘asukaṃ no ṭhānaṃ rujjati, bhesajjaṃ khādāmā’ti vicaranti, ko añño mayā sadiso nirogo nāmā”ti evaṃ mānakaraṇaṃ ārogyamado.

Sabbesampi jīvitaṃ nāma pabhaṅguraṃ dukkhānubandhañca, tadubhayaṃ anoloketvā pabandhaṭṭhitiṃ paccayasulabhatañca nissāya “ciraṃ jīviṃ, ciraṃ jīvāmi, ciraṃ jīvissāmi, sukhaṃ jīviṃ, sukhaṃ jīvāmi, sukhaṃ jīvissāmī”ti evaṃ mānakaraṇaṃ jīvitamado.
